decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt is a flagship extension of an established, popular biodynamic range at the core of the firm's identity, has stayed visible for two years without signs of an aspiration shortfall, and in a growing industry offers no trigger for problemistic search.

The mild sliced cheese is close to the firm's in-house cheesemaking competence and has its own page; results are still early, and the industry's growth gives enough slack to carry it while performance is judged against aspirations.

The sliced butter cheese uses existing cheesemaking resources at low incremental cost and is recently launched, so absent clear evidence of underperformance management would keep it rather than redirect resources.
